project.description: The project id, the folder name.

app.description: The app (domain id) this project is a copy of.

also.description: Other apps this project also runs, at their current versions (a firm's GST, income tax and notices on the same clients). Their records of type scope: project live in this project too.

version.description: The app version its template was taken from. Default the app's current version.

template.description: The template card it was made from (an id in app.yaml templates).

copied_from.description: The project it was copied from (no records are copied).

study.description: The study key linking projects across apps, e.g. MW-301.

status.description: The status it starts in; default active. Nothing runs in a draft.

people.description: People and their roles in this project.

note.description: Shown beside the role, e.g. owner.

connections.description: Connections the project uses, by id.

plugin.description: The installed plugin it goes through.

settings.description: Per-project settings (a mailbox, a folder), never credentials.

without.description: Template paths left out: workflows/<id>, pages/<id>, views/<id>.

title: MemWise project
description: projects/<id>/project.yaml: one copy of an app, with overrides/ holding whole files that replace the template's.
